text_block_list.text:
One day at noon, as training with Daring Heart
continued toward her Make Debut—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahaha!
Seriously!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Craft, is that even possible?
Tap dancing with an elephant?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we really did dance together!
And he was such a gentlemanly elephant, too!
It was so much fun...”

Beside Daring Heart was Rhein Kraft.
Beneath her innocent demeanor lay an Umamusume
of incredible, hidden potential.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...You're certain... it was
the story about today's dream, right...?"

Air Messiah is a meticulous and earnest Umamusume.
Her abilities leave nothing to be desired,
and she's an honor student who always approaches things with a steady hand.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Oh, Craft...
You talk about it as if it really happened.

I hear the neighboring Cesario is bright and kind.
Yet, beneath that gentle demeanor,
lies a talent capable of overpowering all with a fierce burst of late speed.

They are classmates debuting in the same year. That said,
they all seem to have a different air about them
compared to Daring Heart's usual circle of friends—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Someday, let's all
barge right into Craft's dream together♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And if we throw a loud party...
even a sleepyhead like Kraft will wake right up—
just kidding, hehe!
choice_data_list: (Still—she looks like she's having so much fun.)
(Still—she seems to be having so much fun.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Geez, looking at me from so far away again...
—Come here!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Would you like something to eat?
We have octopus-shaped wieners, tamagoyaki,
mini hamburg steaks... Help yourself to whatever you like♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“My recommendation is the tamagoyaki!
Cesario's seasoning is nice and sweet—it's so delicious~!”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh! In that case, I recommend Southern potato salad with celery!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
By the way... did you need something
from Heart-san?

I explain that I merely happened to see them.
Looking closely at the four of them standing side by side as we talk... each one truly radiates a distinctly different presence.
choice_data_list: ...You two really get along well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidding?
Saying we get along well is utterly ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
What?!
H-Heart-san?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—We get along su~per well, you know!
Right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because,
we share the exact same passion!
"I'll tell you the reason, but in exchange, I want you to set up a mock race for us"—that was what she told me, leading to our preparations after school.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"—Let's get right to it, then.
Everyone, ready yourselves."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's Cesario for you!
Her on and off switches are wildly distinct.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you don't need to think about anything.
Just—feel our passion!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhhhh...!!
I was overwhelmed. These girls hadn't even debuted yet. And yet, it felt as though I were watching an actual race—

My chest trembles. The sheer spirit,
the sheer passion of each and every one of them... I can feel it all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!!
I'm going to win this...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!
That was fun!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer?
—Did you feel our passion?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you very much.
But I'm going to polish my skills even more!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: On the Triple Tiara route, I'll show you races that are even hotter and more thrilling!

There are two major routes
in the Twinkle Series.

First is the Classic Triple Crown route,
aiming for the Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun, and Kikuka Sho.
And the other is—

The Triple Tiara route, consisting of the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho.
All of these girls—are aspiring for the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Four Umamusume with an extraordinary passion for the Tiara route gathered at Tracen Academy—and what's more, ended up in the very same class!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Question! What do you think happens next?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
That is so like you, though!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"On the day we ended up in the same class,
after general introductions were over...
we all stayed and talked together!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —About the dream I want to fulfill on the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to show everyone the exact same brilliant sparkle
that those Tiara Umamusume showed me...
I'm determined to do it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"And... if someone comes along who looks up to me
just like I looked up to them...
that would make me the happiest person ever!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how many times I hear Craft's dream, it's wonderful.
Well then, I should also..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—My dream is to triumph on the Tiara route
and become a foundation for the future.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
Such a sudden, sharp look in your eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Drawing from the great, flowing river carved by those who came before, she builds up achievements along the Tiara route—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...And someday, I'd love to get involved
in training the next generation, you know? ♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's back.
I see. Cesario sure sets her sights high, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And? What about
the Messiah?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...My dream is...
—to prove my mother's greatness.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: My mother... a Tiara Umamusume who once ran the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That her mother was a magnificent Umamusume.
...As her daughter, I will prove that strength.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, aren't they amazing?
The passion of my peers!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Each of them heading into the race with their own uncompromising motives.
Isn't it just the best?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: I'd also like to hear how you talked about your dream.
I want to hear how you talked about your dream, too

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's right, Heart-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san's passionate stories...
I want to hear more of them!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh.
—I've been waiting to hear you say that!

With a bright laugh—
Daring Heart broke into a light run.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone,
listen up, please!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Heart-san?" "What is it, what is it?"
"What's wrong...?" "Heart~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to win the Triple Tiara!
And become the ultimate queen!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Born in America, raised in America.
Why is someone like me running in Japan?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's simple!
Because I was captivated
by Japan's Triple Tiara races.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It was incredible!
Brilliant yet fierce,
a clash of hearts against hearts—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My intuition told me this race was made for me!
The moment my heart raced—I was already running.
To tell my parents I was going to Japan!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: At the top development club where Papa works, "Hilesta Academy," I'll polish myself, hone my skills, and then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —This is where... I met everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll say it again.
My dream is to take the Triple Tiara...
and become the Queen!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready?
Let us clash with our ultimate passion!

At Daring Heart's proud declaration,
the onlookers offered a smattering of applause.
Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Heart-san...
She really is so cool.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Still—I cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
—I cannot give up on my dream of the Tiara.

Faced with the fierce, burning gazes of her rivals—
Daring Heart smiled with deep satisfaction.
